newsitem.title: CANADA: Bell Canada offers C$150 mln debentures.
newsitem.headline: Bell Canada offers C$150 mln debentures.

text.p: BCE Inc unit Bell Canada said on Tuesday that it issued C$150 million of subordinated debentures in Canada.
The 7.65 percent subordinated debentures, Series 2, will be dated December 30, 1996, will mature on December 30, 2031 and will be issued at 99.541.

The Series 2 debentures will be offered to the public at prices to be negotiated by the underwriters with the purchasers. A preliminary prospectus relating to the issue will be filed with the various securities commissions in Canada, Bell Canada said.
The issue is intended to replace the C$150 million of Series 8 preferred shares redeemed on December 1, the company said.
Preliminary ratings for the Series 2 subordinated debentures have been established at A(low) by Dominion Bond Rating Service and A(low) by Canadian Bond Rating Service, Bell Canada said.
